pages.text: While piranhas are, in reality, passive and shy creatures, these horrid creatures live up to their vicious and aggressive reputation.

One can call upon a loyal snapper through the use of a $(l:focuses/wild/hunting_focus)Hunting Focus$() underwater or through $(l:crafts/staff/abyss_staff)Abyss Staff$(), or through a ritual which summons one without a limited lifespan.
Right-clicking on a loyal Snapper with meat will heal them.
